description: Apply the FINAL AGREED DESIGN visual tightening: transparent-when-inactive AQI/PM2.5 pills with dark-green text/outline and translucent-lime active state; dark-green search focus ring (not translucent lime); exact lime #d1f470 for the photo/pill lime surfaces; map panel radius confirmed at home-aligned 14px; no heavy resting shadows; and finish removal of any lingering removed-list UI. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: AQI/PM2.5 PILLS - restyle .vl-live-layer in the styled-jsx block (~line 2617). Inactive/resting state: background:transparent (remove rgba(255,255,255,.58)); remove backdrop-filter:blur(9px) and -webkit-backdrop-filter; remove any resting box-shadow; border:1.5px solid #1a3a2a (or a subtle dark-green outline per spec) with color:#1a3a2a text. Remove the resting frosted look entirely. Keep a sane hover (no heavy shadow; a light lime tint is fine) and the existing :focus-visible dark-green ring. Active state .vl-live-layer[aria-pressed="true"]: translucent lime based on #d1f470 (e.g. background:var(--lime-tint) or rgba(209,244,112,.5-.6)) with color:#1a3a2a and a #1a3a2a border. The controls stay top-right of the map (.vl-live-map-controls already position:absolute;top:...;right:18px) separate from the centered search - keep that.

SEARCH FOCUS RING - in .vl-live-search-field:focus-within (~line 2562) change outline:3px solid rgba(209,244,112,.78) (translucent lime) to a DARK-GREEN ring: outline:3px solid #1a3a2a (or rgba(26,58,42,.X)). Keep border-color:#1a3a2a, the single outer border, white background, outline-offset, and the neutralized inner input (no double inner border). Remove any heavy resting box-shadow on the field if present (the spec says no heavy resting shadows; a subtle focus shadow is acceptable).

EXACT LIME - audit for places that mix #f5fde0 and #d1f470 where 'same lime' is intended, specifically the photo pill (.vl-live-photo-count) and any photo fallback surface. The pill must use exact #d1f470. The poi.park MAP STYLE color #f5fde0 (~line 189) is a Google map tint, NOT a pill/photo lime - leave it unless it is clearly a photo-fallback surface. Fix only the pill/photo-fallback mixing.

MAP PANEL RADIUS - confirm the map stage uses the home-aligned 14px (--r-panel:14px; .vl-live-map-stage border-radius:14px). If any 20px radius remains on the map panel from an earlier cycle, set it back to 14px. Confirm there is no heavy resting box-shadow on .vl-live-map-stage or .vl-live-place-card (box-shadow:none at rest; a subtle shadow only on hover/focus if any).

FINISH REMOVED-LIST CLEANUP - verify (and remove if any linger) on the MAP: Expand/Collapse controls, mapExpanded state, .is-expanded sizing, floating .vl-live-map-photos gallery, floating photo tabs/number pill ON THE MAP, separate on-map place-information overlay, visible zoom/fullscreen/street-view/map-type controls (keep disableDefaultUI:true), and any drag/zoom/keyboard/pan/expand instructional UI. Most were already removed on this branch; do not reintroduce and delete any remnants. (The photo gallery + number pill correctly live in the LEFT card - keep those.)

Extend/adjust src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx with behavioral assertions for the restyle: inactive pills have NO white/frosted background and NO backdrop-filter (assert the computed/inline style or the absence of the old classes/values - prefer asserting the active pill gets a lime-based background and the inactive pill does not carry rgba(255,255,255,.58)/blur). Keep assertions behavioral and not brittle to exact pixel values where possible. Ensure the left-card photo pill + identity + per-layer result-block-swap test from the branch stays green, and the req-06 Place-photo attribution guard stays green.
acceptance_criteria: Inactive AQI/PM2.5 pills render with transparent background, dark-green (#1a3a2a) text and a subtle dark-green outline; no rgba(255,255,255,.58) fill, no backdrop-filter blur, no resting shadow.
Active AQI/PM2.5 pill uses a translucent lime (#d1f470-based) background with #1a3a2a text/border.
Search field focus ring is dark-green (#1a3a2a), not translucent lime; single outer border, white bg, no double inner border.
The photo pill (.vl-live-photo-count) and any 'same lime' photo-fallback surface use exact #d1f470.
Map panel radius is 14px with no heavy resting shadow; place card has no heavy resting shadow.
None of the removed-list map UI is present (expand/collapse, on-map gallery/pill, on-map place overlay, visible map controls, drag/zoom/pan/expand instructions).
VayuLokLive test suite remains green including the pill-restyle, left-card, and req-06 attribution assertions.
verification: grep -n "rgba(255,255,255,.58)\|rgba(255, 255, 255, .58)" src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx  (expect no match on the layer pill)
